newsitem.title: FRANCE: Commercial court delays Air Liberte decision to Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: Commercial court delays Air Liberte decision to Nov 5.

text.p: British Airways Plc (BA) said in a statement on Wednesday that the Creteil commercial court would decide on November 5 on the offer by BA's TAT and groupe Rivaud to acquire insolvent Air Liberte.
"This after a request by British Airways for additional information on the dossier," the statement said.

The court had originally been due to decise to day whether to accept the offer, which would see BA take a 70 percent stake for a 440 million franc investment while French bank Rivaud would have 30 percent after an additional 190 million francs investment.
The administrator for Air Liberte, Gilles Baronie, told Reuters on Tuesday that a possible bid by Richard Branson's Virgin Express had not yet materialised.
Air Liberte went into administration on September 26.
